section4.p1: If gambling is negatively impacting your life, ask yourself:
section4.li1: Do you skip school/work to gamble?
section4.li2: Do you gamble out of boredom?
section4.li3: Do you spend long hours gambling alone?
section4.li4: Have people criticized your gambling habits?
section4.li5: Do you neglect family, friends, or hobbies due to gambling?
section4.li6: Have you borrowed or stolen money for gambling?
section4.li7: Do you gamble until all your money is gone?
section4.li8: Do you chase losses immediately after losing?
